0022600202.text: The Kings (1-8, 0-4 at home) sit 5th in the Pacific and 15th in the West on a two-game losing streak as they host the Heat (3-6), who are 3rd in the Southeast and 9th in the East after a loss. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons, who is out following Achilles surgery, and Maxime Raynaud, who is out with a dislocated knee after averaging 12.5 points and 26.5 minutes per game last season. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not yet met this season, and the Kings' most recent meeting was a 130-117 loss to Miami in Sacramento on January 20.
